audit.whatIsWrong: Full-layer level chart disagreed with the content layer (which matches the packet) on all seven rows.
audit.why: Even 1-2, Ziggs' 850-range artillery wins 3-5, Malzahar takes over from 6 onward: point-click R picks an immobile enemy whose only escape is a long-cooldown Satchel. 50.02% WR, 2737 games — a coinflip resolving on engage.
audit.corrected: Full sides aligned to content win[]; whys rewritten per row.

audit.why: Spikes: his 3-5 poke window, Malzahar's 6 (pick tool vs a waveclear ult), Lost Chapter roam freedom, late pick-and-objective edge — spikes[0..3] already state these with counterplay.

audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.cooldowns has no digit; two copy-paste-bleed bullets; two applicable interactions absent: Satchel Charge deals max-health-scaling damage (raw MR is not the full answer) and Short Fuse's empowered auto is the poke-combo tell.
audit.why: Satchel Charge is 20s rank 1 / 12s max — his only self-peel against a point-click suppress; his Q falls to 4s at max rank. Both missingInteractions folded into cooldowns and the don'ts.
audit.corrected: Numbers added, bleed bullets replaced with Ziggs-specific content, both missing interactions now on the page.
sources: kits: Ziggs W 20/18/16/14/12 percentHealth, Q 6/5.5/5/4.5/4, P autoReset

edits.before: E a caster minion and let the visions farm for you — your lane is a macro pattern, not a duel, from the first wave.
edits.after: Level 1 is an even farm start — neither has a kill threat; just don't stand in Bouncing Bomb lines while last-hitting.

edits.before: Q online: the silence is your trade answer. Use it on his engage spell, not on poke he can walk around.
edits.after: Still even at 2 — he pokes but cannot commit, so both of you prioritise the wave and bank early gold.

edits.before: W voidlings turn your shove permanent — the wave hits his tower while you ward, roam-shadow, or just exist safely.
edits.after: Level 3 is his: 850-range Bouncing Bomb and mine zoning push you off farm — match the shove with E and take no poke.

edits.before: Lost Chapter and the machine is complete: E-hops fund themselves, the wave is always crashing, and his tower is always bleeding.
edits.after: Through 4-5 his artillery range and Satchel zoning keep the pressure his — hold your passive for the bombs and farm with E.

edits.before: Nether Grasp online — with ANY jungle presence you now have a guaranteed kill button. The lane bends around your 6.
edits.after: Nether Grasp online: Ziggs is immobile except a 20-second Satchel — catch him stepping up and the suppress deletes him.

edits.before: Liandry's spike: visions melt waves AND health bars. Suppress-into-burn kills through most defensive answers.
edits.after: Lost Chapter matches his waveclear and frees you to roam — he is stuck shoving and cannot follow your map play.

edits.before: Late Malz is a number: one suppression on their carry equals one won teamfight. Shield up, flank smart, press R.
edits.after: Two-plus items: your R picks and voidling DPS outvalue his stationary poke — lock a carry and the fight is 4v5.

edits.before: - Ziggs Satchel Charge: matchup-defining — His knockback escape — he is catchable only while it is down. Count it out loud if you must. - Your spell shield (Iron Boundary) has one job: the moment it all goes wrong. - The R has one too: the moment it all goes right.
edits.after: - Ziggs Satchel Charge: 20s at rank 1, 12s max — his only escape; he is catchable exactly while it is down. - His Q falls to 4s at max rank; the glowing Short Fuse auto is the poke tell — step back on the wind-up. - Satchel scales off max health, so raw MR alone is not the answer.

edits.before: Pop-and-punish: poke his shield off with a cheap E-tick, then Q-W-E the gap before it rebuilds — full rotations only ever land on shieldless targets.
edits.after: E-W keeps the wave crashing without you stepping into his 850-range bomb lines — he must choose between matching your shove and poking, never both.

edits.before: Trading into him with YOUR shield down — you are the squishiest scaling mage in the pool the moment the purple bubble disappears.
edits.after: A Q into mines into the Short Fuse auto chunks a shieldless Malzahar — his poke is cheap at that range and yours is not; wait it out.

edits.before: Flash + Teleport standard — TP doubles your shove-tax map game. Ghost-cleanse setups exist into hard dive; Ignite pairs with R kill threats if you want lane blood.
edits.after: Flash + Teleport standard — TP turns each wave crash into a cross-map play. Ghost-Cleanse exists into hard dive; Ignite pairs with R kill threats if you want lane blood.

edits.before: Ziggs wins by landing Satchel Charge, denying your pattern, and renting you the lane at a range markup.
edits.after: Ziggs wins the range war: 850-range bombs and mines tax every last-hit until your shield never rebuilds.
